sources.beginner: nextgen-panel: wf-ledger-explorer (LedgerExplorer.jsx:110-117) runs the Ekene capstone ledger on default and the capstone lesson says every field is in the tiles; jan voidage is hand-calc from lesson-stated Np. All six are also printed in full in the lessons.
sources.intermediate: nextgen-panel: wf-pattern-explorer (PatternExplorer.jsx:122-129) for fields 1-4 on the capstone allocation by default; Hall ratio = 0.5/0.35 from m04/l02; Chan slope only as printed in m05/l02:11 (raw rows not provided). All six printed in lessons.
sources.advanced: nextgen-panel: wf-design-explorer (DesignExplorer.jsx:141-157) Layers and Forecast modes run the capstone column and element by default; implied fraction hand-calc (advanced/m05/l02). All six printed in lessons.

fields.recommendation: Course-level: the capstone reuses the lesson dataset (Ekene flood, fixture waterflood.json), the working-the-capstone lesson tells the learner to read the answers off the panel tiles at the capstone settings, and the lessons print the graded value in full. Precision and tolerance are fine; the question for the owner is whether to re-base the three capstones on an unseen case (as the cementing and newer wave courses do) so the panel is a tool rather than an answer sheet.
fields.evidence: Tile uses fmt(v, 6) with maximumFractionDigits 6, so it prints about 1.0349 (probe) up to 1.034900 trimmed; rounding error is at most 5e-7 at 6 dp and still under 5e-5 if only 4 show, against tol 5e-4.
